messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: conv-gpu-pool queue length spike detected (>1200 requests) for model-preview:v2.3 rollout at 1834506789. Autoscaler failed 3x to add nodes. Severity: P1

oncall-nyc: Ack. Paging oncall. I’m taking this.

ida: I see 90-100% GPU util on a subset of nodes, and queue depth rising. Throttles triggered: 429s ramping.

sam: Raw metrics:
```
queue_length: 1243
p95_latency: 920ms
gpu_utilization: 98%
available_capacity: 0
autoscaler_retries: 3
```

mira: Any clue which change caused this? We just rolled model-preview from v2.1 -> v2.3 10m ago. v2.3 increased context window + enabled kv-cache eager-warm.

ida: Looks like context length distribution jumped. Median context len ~5k tokens vs usual 2k. That would blow up KV cache footprint and reduce throughput on batching.

oncall-nyc: Runbook step 1: reduce traffic to failing pool and route to fallback. Who can flip routing?

sam: I can. Pushing emergency routing to route 25% -> model-preview:v2.1 fallback now. Command: 
```
redwood route update --from model-preview:v2.3 --to model-preview:v2.1 --percent 25 --dry-run=false
```

opsbot: action accepted: routing change applied (25% -> v2.1).

ida: Good. Need to either scale pool or revert rollout. Autoscaler failing due to quota in region. Error: "insufficient GPU quota" on provider.

mira: Can we temporarily disable eager-kv-warm for v2.3 to reduce memory? If not, revert.

tom: I’m checking policy for quick revert. kubectl rollout undo would revert the deployment but we use Canary by weight. We can set route back to 100% v2.1 to be fastest.

leah: Customer impact—observed elevated 503/504 for some API keys. From logs: keys with prefix cust-E had 12% error spike. Support alerting already created.

oncall-nyc: Next actions: (A) increase fallback routing to 100% until autoscaler issue resolved (B) attempt manual capacity add (C) consider reverting config on v2.3 to disable kv-warm.

sam: Increasing fallback to 100% now.

opsbot: action accepted: routing change applied (100% -> model-preview:v2.1).

ida: Queue length dropping from 1243 -> 300 in last 90s. p95 latency starting to recover.

sam: Opening ticket with infra to lift GPU quota in us-east-1: ticket INFRA-4321. ETA unknown.

mira: While we wait, let's mitigate on the model side. @tom can you add a temporary model-config override to disable eager-kv-warm? That should reduce per-request GPU memory overhead and increase throughput.

tom: Pushing config override to v2.3 (disable_kv_warm = true) via ops API:
```
opsctl model-config set model-preview:v2.3 disable_kv_warm=true --env live
```

opsbot: action queued: model-config change scheduled for immediate application.

ida: Noted. Also please bump the request timeout on the gateway to avoid cascading 504s: gateway timeout -> 20s -> 30s for the pool.

sam: Done. `gatewayctl set-timeout --pool conv-gpu-pool --timeout 30s`

leah: Support: drafting customer notification. Affected: ~3% of active customers saw degraded performance, highest impact for chat-heavy customers using long-context flows.

mira: Good work. Any signs of regressions other than context length? Token generation per request slightly higher due to deterministic sampling change in v2.3 but that's minor. KV warm + context seems primary.

ida: Autoscaler logs show failures creating instances due to provider quota. We can do a hotfix: move some workload to another region with spare capacity (us-west-2). That requires updating routing and cross-region latency concerns.

sam: I can spin up a temporary dedicated-pool in us-west-2 if infra approves. Opened INFRA-4322 for cross-region burst.

oncall-nyc: Handoff in 30m to @mira. Current status: routing back to v2.1 at 100%, queue draining (now 73), p95 latency 240ms, incident impact reduced but not resolved until either quota or model config changed. Actions in progress: INFRA-4321, INFRA-4322, model-config override applied.

mira: I’m taking over in 30. @ida please keep monitoring steady-state and confirm no customers continue erroring. Also share evaluation bump for regression tests to decide permanent action (revert vs config).

ida: Copy. I'll monitor logs and post hourly updates. Current metrics snapshot: queue 12, p95 180ms, 503 rate back to baseline.

leah: Support: will send an interim note to affected customers mentioning transient capacity issues during rollout and that traffic was routed to a stable model with reduced impact.

oncall-nyc: Marking incident as mitigated for live traffic. Leave P1 until autoscaler/quota is resolved and v2.3 config decision is finalized.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity -> mitigated (live traffic stable). Next update scheduled by mira at +60m.

mira: Thanks. Handoff note for night team: root cause likely combination of increased median context length + kv-cache warm behavior in model-preview:v2.3 causing per-request GPU memory spike and saturating node capacity; autoscaler attempted but failed due to cloud GPU quota. Mitigations applied: immediate routing to v2.1, model-config override to disable eager_kv_warm on v2.3, increased gateway timeout, infra tickets opened for quota and cross-region bursting.

oncall-nyc: Leaving channel. Good job team :thumbsup:

mira: Will follow up with regression evals and decision to revert or ship config fix.

ida: Logging final metrics and will attach traces to INFRA-4321.

sam: I'll coordinate with infra on capacity timeline.

leah: Will close support ticket after customer outreach.

opsbot: NOTE: incident incident-1834506789 state=mitigated assignees=[oncall-nyc,mira]
